name: workflows
description: Multi-agent workflow (DAG) artifacts: validate/render/run .workflow.yaml graphs, run list/status/reconcile/cancel, manager tools (workflow_validate/dispatch/status), /workflow + /followup

maxNodes.description: Soft cap on nodes per workflow graph (exceeding it warns; validation refuses above the hard ceiling of 32). A workflow's own limits.maxNodes overrides.

maxRuntimeMins.description: Default per-node cap in minutes on actual worker run time (a node's maxRuntimeMins overrides); time queued waiting for a provider-lane slot does not count. When the cap elapses the in-flight attempt is interrupted and the node fails immediately; remaining attempts are not retried.

path.description: Directory holding *.workflow.yaml graphs; runs live under <path>/runs
